package auth

// Golden generator for cliproxy-rs. RUST_GOLDEN=<file> go test -run TestRustGoldenHome ./sdk/cliproxy/auth/

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/sdk/cliproxy/executionregistry"
)

type rustObs struct {
	RequestID    string `json:"request_id"`
	CredentialID string `json:"credential_id"`
	Model        string `json:"model"`
	RequestKind  string `json:"request_kind"`
	StartedNanos int64  `json:"started_unix_nano"`
	Accounted    bool   `json:"accounted"`
}

type rustCfg struct {
	MaxPartBytes       int `json:"max_part_bytes"`
	MaxPartCount       int `json:"max_part_count"`
	MaxRevisionBytes   int `json:"max_revision_bytes"`
	MaxAggregateGroups int `json:"max_aggregate_groups"`
	MaxDetails         int `json:"max_details"`
	MaxStringBytes     int `json:"max_string_bytes"`
}

func TestRustGoldenHome(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("RUST_GOLDEN")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("RUST_GOLDEN not set")
	}
	doc := map[string]any{}
	base := time.Date(2026, 7, 21, 11, 59, 58, 0, time.UTC)

	mkObs := func(n int, credFn func(int) string, modelFn func(int) string, accountedFn func(int) bool) []rustObs {
		var obs []rustObs
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			obs = append(obs, rustObs{
				RequestID:    fmt.Sprintf("req-%04d", (i*7919)%n),
				CredentialID: credFn(i),
				Model:        modelFn(i),
				RequestKind:  []string{"http", "stream", "websocket"}[i%3],
				StartedNanos: base.Add(time.Duration(i%5) * 1500 * time.Millisecond).UnixNano(),
				Accounted:    accountedFn(i),
			})
		}
		return obs
	}
	def := rustCfg{262144, 64, 16777216, 100000, 10000, 256}
	small := rustCfg{1024, 4, 4096, 100000, 10000, 256}
	type goCase struct {
		rev, barrier int64
		observed     time.Time
	}
	unix := func(sec int64) int64 { return time.Unix(sec, 0).UnixNano() }
	repeat := strings.Repeat
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  rustCfg
		obs  []rustObs
		// The Go encoder tests' own revision, barrier and observation time
		// (home_in_flight_publisher_test.go); their zero start times become the epoch,
		// as a Rust scope always records its start.
		goCase *goCase
	}{
		{"empty", def, nil, nil},
		{"fixture_like", def, []rustObs{
			{"req-1", "cred-a", "gpt-5", "sse", base.UnixNano(), true},
			{"req-2", "cred-a", "gpt-5", "http", base.Add(time.Second).UnixNano(), true},
			{"req-3", "cred-a", "GPT-5(high)", "http", base.Add(123456789).UnixNano(), false},
		}, nil},
		{"multipart_truncated", small, mkObs(40, func(i int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("cred-%d", i%3) }, func(i int) string { return "model-<x>&" }, func(i int) bool { return i%2 == 0 }), nil},
		{"part_count_limit", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 100000, 10000, 256}, mkObs(30, func(i int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("c%d", i%2) }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"aggregate_overflow", rustCfg{262144, 64, 16777216, 3, 10000, 256}, mkObs(10, func(i int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("c%d", i) }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"aggregates_dont_fit", rustCfg{1024, 1, 1024, 100000, 10000, 256}, mkObs(40, func(i int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("credential-%02d", i) }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"long_strings", rustCfg{262144, 64, 16777216, 100000, 10000, 8}, []rustObs{
			{"request-ééé-long", "c1", "unknown-model-name", "http", base.UnixNano(), false},
			{"r", "c1", "m", "stream", base.UnixNano(), true},
			{"  ", "c1", "m", "http", base.UnixNano(), true},
		}, nil},
		{"long_credential", rustCfg{262144, 64, 16777216, 100000, 10000, 4}, []rustObs{{"r", "credential", "m", "http", base.UnixNano(), true}}, nil},
		{"max_details", rustCfg{262144, 64, 16777216, 100000, 3, 256}, mkObs(9, func(int) string { return "c" }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"zero_config", rustCfg{}, mkObs(2, func(int) string { return "c" }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"revision_limit", rustCfg{1024, 8, 1500, 100000, 10000, 256}, mkObs(25, func(i int) string { return "c" }, func(int) string { return "m" }, func(int) bool { return true }), nil},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezePreservesPartitionsAndBarrier", rustCfg{1024, 64, 16384, 100000, 1, 256}, []rustObs{
			{"req-a", "cred", "gpt-5", "http", unix(10), true},
			{"req-b", "cred", "gpt-5", "sse", unix(11), false},
		}, &goCase{9, 14, time.Unix(12, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeUsesOverflowWithoutPartialAggregates", rustCfg{256, 1, 256, 1, 0, 256}, []rustObs{
			{"", "a", "m1", "http", 0, false},
			{"", "b", "m2", "http", 0, true},
		}, &goCase{10, 15, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeUsesDeterministicBoundedMultipartFrames", rustCfg{300, 8, 2048, 8, 3, 256}, []rustObs{
			{"req-c", "cred", "model", "http", unix(12), false},
			{"req-a", "cred", "model", "http", unix(10), false},
			{"req-b", "cred", "model", "http", unix(11), false},
		}, &goCase{4, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeOverflowsWhenFinalAggregatePartExceedsPartCount", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 3, 0, 512}, []rustObs{
			{"", repeat("a", 300), repeat("a", 300), "", 0, true},
			{"", repeat("b", 300), repeat("b", 300), "", 0, true},
			{"", repeat("c", 300), repeat("c", 300), "", 0, true},
		}, &goCase{13, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeTruncatesDetailsBeforeTotalOverflow", rustCfg{512, 8, 1000, 8, 5, 128}, func() []rustObs {
			var obs []rustObs
			for index := 0; index < 5; index++ {
				obs = append(obs, rustObs{repeat(string(rune('a'+index)), 60), "cred", "model", "http", unix(int64(index)), false})
			}
			return obs
		}(), &goCase{12, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeBoundsStringsAndExcludesSensitiveFields", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 8, 1, 8}, []rustObs{
			{repeat("request", 20), repeat("credential", 20), repeat("model", 20), repeat("kind", 20), 0, false},
		}, &goCase{3, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeOverflowsForRawAggregateKey", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 2, 1, 8}, []rustObs{
			{"", "credential-id-exceeds-limit", "model", "http", 0, false},
		}, &goCase{0, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeKeepsRawAggregateGroupsDistinct", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 1, 0, 8}, []rustObs{
			{"", "credential-a", "model", "http", 0, false},
			{"", "credential-b", "model", "http", 0, false},
		}, &goCase{0, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeDropsInvalidDetailsWithoutDiscardingAggregates", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 2, 2, 64}, []rustObs{
			{"", "cred-a", "model-a", "http", unix(1), false},
			{"request-b", "cred-a", "model-a", "http", unix(2), false},
		}, &goCase{21, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeCanonicalizesUnaccountedModelsWithFallback", rustCfg{1024, 2, 2048, 3, 2, 64}, []rustObs{
			{"request-a", "cred-a", "GPT-5(HIGH)", "http", unix(1), false},
			{"request-b", "cred-b", "   ", "http", unix(2), false},
		}, &goCase{22, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
		{"TestEncodeHomeInFlightFreezeSetsGlobalDetailTruncationMetadata", rustCfg{300, 8, 2048, 4, 2, 8}, []rustObs{
			{repeat("r", 32), "cred-a", "model-a", "http", unix(1), false},
			{"request-b", "cred-b", "model-b", "http", unix(2), false},
			{"request-c", "cred-c", "model-c", "http", unix(3), false},
		}, &goCase{0, 0, time.Unix(20, 0)}},
	}
	observedAt := time.Date(2026, 7, 21, 12, 0, 0, 120000000, time.UTC)
	var inflight []map[string]any
	for _, tc := range cases {
		rev, barrier, observed := int64(7), int64(11), observedAt
		if tc.goCase != nil {
			rev, barrier, observed = tc.goCase.rev, tc.goCase.barrier, tc.goCase.observed.UTC()
		}
		freeze := executionregistry.Freeze{Revision: rev, BarrierRevision: barrier}
		for _, o := range tc.obs {
			freeze.Executions = append(freeze.Executions, executionregistry.Observation{
				RequestID: o.RequestID, CredentialID: o.CredentialID, Model: o.Model, RequestKind: o.RequestKind,
				StartedAt: time.Unix(0, o.StartedNanos), Accounted: o.Accounted,
			})
		}
		cfg := HomeInFlightPublisherConfig{
			SnapshotInterval:   2 * time.Second,
			MaxPartBytes:       tc.cfg.MaxPartBytes,
			MaxPartCount:       tc.cfg.MaxPartCount,
			MaxRevisionBytes:   tc.cfg.MaxRevisionBytes,
			MaxAggregateGroups: tc.cfg.MaxAggregateGroups,
			MaxDetails:         tc.cfg.MaxDetails,
			MaxStringBytes:     tc.cfg.MaxStringBytes,
		}
		frames := encodeHomeInFlightFreeze(freeze, observed, cfg)
		var raws []string
		for _, f := range frames {
			raw, err := json.Marshal(f)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			raws = append(raws, string(raw))
		}
		inflight = append(inflight, map[string]any{"name": tc.name, "cfg": tc.cfg, "observations": tc.obs, "observed_unix_nano": observed.UnixNano(), "revision": rev, "barrier": barrier, "frames": raws})
	}
	doc["inflight"] = inflight

	// Home dispatch error decoding.
	var errorsOut []map[string]any
	for _, raw := range []string{
		`{"error":{"type":"credential_concurrency_exceeded","message":"limit","retryable":true,"retry_after_ms":750}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"credential_model_concurrency_exceeded","retry_after_ms":0}}`,
		`{"error":{"code":"model_cooldown","message":" wait ","retry_after_ms":1500,"request_retry":2}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"model_cooldown","retry_after_ms":-5,"request_retry":-1}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"MODEL_NOT_FOUND"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"unauthorized"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"user_credits_insufficient"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"user_period_limit_exceeded"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"refresh_temporarily_unavailable"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"concurrency_protocol_required"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":"request_retry_exceeded","message":"x"}}`,
		`{"error":{"type":" ","code":" auth_not_found "}}`,
		`{"error":{"message":"no code"}}`,
		`{"error":null}`,
		`{"error":"text"}`,
		`{"error":{"type":5}}`,
		`{"auth":{"id":"a"}}`,
		`not json`,
	} {
		entry := map[string]any{"raw": raw}
		err := decodeHomeDispatchError([]byte(raw))
		if err != nil {
			var authErr *Error
			if errors.As(err, &authErr) {
				entry["code"] = authErr.Code
				entry["message"] = authErr.Message
				entry["retryable"] = authErr.Retryable
				entry["status"] = authErr.HTTPStatus
			}
			var busy *HomeConcurrencyBusyError
			var cooldown *homeDispatchRetryAfterError
			switch {
			case errors.As(err, &busy):
				entry["kind"] = "busy"
				if ra := busy.RetryAfter(); ra != nil {
					entry["retry_after_ms"] = ra.Milliseconds()
				}
			case errors.As(err, &cooldown):
				entry["kind"] = "cooldown"
				if ra := cooldown.RetryAfter(); ra != nil {
					entry["retry_after_ms"] = ra.Milliseconds()
				}
				if limit, ok := cooldown.RequestRetryLimit(); ok {
					entry["request_retry"] = limit
				}
			default:
				entry["kind"] = "plain"
			}
			if h := SafeResponseHeaders(err); h != nil {
				entry["retry_after_header"] = h.Get("Retry-After")
			}
		}
		errorsOut = append(errorsOut, entry)
	}
	doc["dispatch_errors"] = errorsOut

	var keys []map[string]any
	for _, m := range []string{" GPT-5(High) ", "gpt-5(8192)", "gpt-5(-1)", "gpt-5(2147483647)", "gpt-5(2147483648)", "gpt-5(12345678901)", "gpt-5(fast)", "(high)", "a (b) (low)", "x()", "m(  )", "\tModel\n", "a(MAX)", "", strings.Repeat("m", 257)} {
		key, valid := validCanonicalHomeConcurrencyModelKey(m)
		keys = append(keys, map[string]any{"in": m, "key": key, "valid": valid})
	}
	doc["model_keys"] = keys

	var envelopes []map[string]any
	for _, raw := range []string{
		`{"concurrency":{"accounted":true,"credential_id":"c","model":"gpt"}}`,
		`{"concurrency":{"accounted":false,"credential_id":"c","model":"gpt"}}`,
		`{"concurrency":{"accounted":true,"credential_id":" c","model":"gpt"}}`,
		`{"concurrency":{"accounted":true,"credential_id":"c","model":"GPT"}}`,
		`{"concurrency":{"accounted":true,"credential_id":"c","model":"gpt(high)"}}`,
		`{"concurrency":null}`,
		`{"concurrency":"x"}`,
		`{"auth":{}}`,
		`[1]`,
		"\xff",
	} {
		env, err := decodeHomeDispatchConcurrencyEnvelope([]byte(raw))
		entry := map[string]any{"raw": raw, "present": env.Present, "ok": err == nil}
		if err == nil && env.Present {
			entry["tuple"] = map[string]any{"accounted": env.Tuple.Accounted, "credential_id": env.Tuple.CredentialID, "model": env.Tuple.Model}
		}
		envelopes = append(envelopes, entry)
	}
	doc["envelopes"] = envelopes

	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
